direction.concept: A bridge shelters a shared gathering; overhead terrain connects screen, mats, entrance and conversation.
direction.substantive_non_glyph_visual: Continuous oblique-overhead river banks and diagonal bridge shelter a screen and seated adults on mats. Nearby chairs and a mic-holding speaker face an attentive conversation cluster. An evocative site drawing, not a surveyed reconstruction of the actual bridge.
direction.expression_system: Graphic architectural illustration, bounded flat colors, hand-drawn rhythm and consistent oblique depth. River, bridge, people and circulation are a connected environment rather than isolated icons.
direction.copy_visual_relationship: Gathering leads to title in upper-left bank clearing, then bridge/screen direction leads to lower-center date/time/venue. Joining/preparation occupy right bank. Editorial text stays flat horizontal rather than printed onto miniature terrain.
direction.whole_visual_layout: Bridge crosses upper-middle; river continues through opposite edges, screening nook left/middle, conversation right. Broad ground clearings: identity470 px, lower-center schedule430–490 px, right utility350–390 px. These connect through terrain rather than a column or footer.
direction.typography_plan: Robust friendly sans title51–58 px, English27–29; descriptor30–31 on410+ px. Date/time37–42, venue33–35; right practical30–32 with335+ usable px. Few consistent local baselines; image angles around them.
direction.color_material_emotion: Dark teal river, apricot bank, light screen and navy type; restrained seating details. Consistent dry drawn edges, sociable adult activity and lively public invitation.
direction.distinction: M3 is overhead continuous terrain with distributed clearings and circulation. M1 is eye-level immersive space with a firm image/notice boundary and vertical facts. Their viewpoint and information topology differ without color.

common_constraints: One separate flat opaque 16:9 poster per role for the same approachable adult neighborhood outdoor film screening and conversation. These are case-specific systems, not a fixed future media roster.

All ten literal entries exactly once. Indexes are zero-based; retain words, case, digits and punctuation. Break only at existing word boundaries; no added labels, credits, logos, QR, watermark or pseudo-print. Ducttape invokes the skill, not physical tape.

Build substantive content-grounded nonglyph construction. Give every practical fact protected contrast and a useful reading path; type-only, tiny-icon and generic title/object/footer solutions do not fulfill this request.

All pixel sizes/positions are 1280x720 DESIGN coordinates, not a rendered QA asset. Actual usage720 is720x405: scale0.5625, so practical30–36 design px becomes16.9–20.3 actual px. Actual Apple SD Gothic Neo Semibold widths at30 design px, indexes0–9:198/214/361/231/165/224/181/138/286/232 px. Leave extra margins; generated lettering differs. Reduce title/frame/image before squeezing facts; inspect actual usage720 readability after generation.

Preserve distinct colon dots, range dash and middle dots with visible word gaps. Check readable raster morphology and order without claiming Unicode authentication. Assign every depicted grip, support and overlap to its person/component; preserve action and genre during correction.

References inform relationships, not copied art, brand, palette, composition or artist-name prompts. Canva records are secondhand root pixel observations; music preview is roughly 2:1, not verified16:9, and market preview is portrait.
